what: Exact neighbourhood and local search around the published 53-point Kakeya set in F_3^5 (Chung, Du and Wesley, arXiv:2608.23691; file kakeya_F3_d5_53.npy in github.com/dualverse-ai/station_data_v2, artifacts/finite_kakeya, downloaded at run time and not copied here)
run: publish gate of run 20261125T103725Z-mathematics, 2026-11-25 10:51-11:06 UTC, Python 3.11, 5 worker processes, code k5/cdw.py at commit 4de4a1e

controls.positive: 53-set plus one point: the search recovers the 53-set once with r = 1 and 53 times with r = 2; with two extra points and r = 3 it recovers it 53 times (all as expected)
controls.negative: published 27-point set in F_3^4: no Kakeya set within r <= 3 (27, 351 and 2925 deletions, all done), consistent with k_4 = 27

conclusion: No Kakeya set of at most 52 points differs from the 53-point set by deleting r <= 3 of its points and adding r - 1 others. This is evidence, not a proof, that 53 is optimal in F_3^5; the proven range is 45 <= k_5 <= 53.
made_with: AI agents working in MV2's name; not checked by a human mathematician
